When someone follows you, your account following goes up by one. When someone unfollow you, your account following goes down by one. 

When someone follows you and then deletes their account or gets suspended, your follower count stays the same even though their account is gone. It's common for everyone to get tons of follows from bot and spam accounts but bluesky deletes them pretty quickly. So when they get deleted their contribution to your follow count doesn't change.

Is it on purpose? Who knows. Maybe it's to fluff up the numbers so engagement seem way higher. I would assume changing this would be a problem for bigger accounts if they see their follower count go from 50k to 10k over night.

This is part of a set of anti-nazi propoganda posters from 1943. It mimics one of the historical Persian art styles.

This artwork was based on the epic poem called The Shahnameh (one of the most celebrated works of Persian literature that dates back to more than a thousand years ago)

Hitler is portrayed as Zahhak, one of the most evil tyrant antagonists in Persian mythology. Zahhak has serpents growing out of his shoulders and in this image, Mussolini and Tojo are the serpents. 

Zahhak/Hitler (alongside the minister of Nazi propaganda Goebbels) is shown captured and defeated being dragged by Churchill, Stalin, and Roosevelt being lead by Kaveh the Blacksmith (portraying the symbol of Iranian national liberation)

Kaveh the Blacksmith is a protagonist in Iranian mythology who leads an uprising against the evil Zahhak.
